cases.test: automatic ROM identification, validated upload/readback and banked CP/M boot
B full directory, full disk, random records and reuse
RAM disk survives three warm boots
80 KiB A to B to A exact independent readback

setup_issue: First auto-host attempt failed before serial traffic because isolated artifact tree lacked tools/recovery_profile.py; corrected tools symlink, then boot succeeded without reset.
limitations: One physical power-on; repeated cold starts and a prolonged soak were not performed in this campaign.
No physical power cycle or RESET during running CP/M; automatic cold-boot recovery remains emulator-qualified for 4.1.0.
Local keyboard/video, floppy drives and operation with absent or faulty RAM were not tested.
